name: outline-fill-hover
title: Outline Fill Hover
description: Text drawn as a stroke that fills from the reading direction on hover — two stacked copies, the fill one clipped by a width transition, so the fill sweeps like ink soaking into a letter rather than fading in.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Brutalist
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Variable Poster
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Hover Fill: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
